name: souroldgeezer-fivee-sim
description: 5E-compatible combat simulation over a single seeded rules kernel, driven from the shell with the bundled fivee command. Stateful encounters whose hit points, initiative, and conditions the engine owns so they cannot be misremembered, plus Monte Carlo damage and win-rate analytics replayed through the same stepper. Covers weapon attacks, movement and reactions, conditions, death saves, and a curated spell set with saving throws, areas, and concentration.
